title: Payments: RED
description: Rate, errors, duration, in that order, because that is the order the questions get asked in. The worst instance panel is fourth and is the one that finds a single bad node: every aggregate on this dashboard hides it.

panels.title: Rate
panels.description: Requests a second. Context for everything else: a zero error rate on no traffic is not good news.

panels.title: Errors, as a share of the budget rate
panels.description: Divided by the budget rate, so 1 is exactly on budget and 14.4 is the fast burn threshold. Reading a burn rate directly beats reading a percentage and doing the arithmetic at 4am.

panels.title: Duration, p99 aggregated across instances
panels.description: Computed by summing histogram buckets. Never avg() of a per instance quantile: with one instance three times slower the average read 361.6 ms while the true p99 was 393.4 ms.

panels.title: Duration, p99 of the worst instance
panels.description: The panel that catches one broken instance. During the measured case this read 906.2 ms while panel 3 read 393.4 ms.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Saturation. Not RED, and the first thing anybody asks for during an incident: how close to the wall are we.
